node.statement: Pointwise estimate: there are universal K_u<infinity and e_0>0 such that, after taking e_0<=min(e_act,e_co), every admissible datum with e<=e_0, every n, U=I_n tensor u_P, and every X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} satisfy q_P(((Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(U)-I)X) <= (C_act*K_u+C_co)*e*q_P(X).
